subject: Workplace Skills
title: Why Authority Isn't Enough
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Why Authority Isn't Enough.

hook.text: A VP ordered a team to change direction. They complied but dragged their feet. Compliance without buy-in is sabotage.

buildup.text: Formal authority gets compliance. Influence gets commitment. Compliance delivers the minimum.

discovery.text: Influence works through persuasion, not power. People follow because they're convinced, not because they're ordered.

twist.text: The people you need most — cross-functional peers, senior leaders.

climax.text: Build influence through credibility, relationships, and clear reasoning. These work regardless of your title.

punchline.text: Influence works everywhere. Authority only works downward.

quiz.question: Why is influence more powerful than formal authority?
options: Influence is permanent while authority can be revoked
Influence generates commitment; authority only generates compliance
People naturally resist all forms of authority
